run_finetune_resnet50: run a ResNet50 fine-tuning job on ImageNet with 10 epochs and learning rate 1e-3
run_finetune_efficientnet: run an EfficientNet fine-tuning job on ImageNet using the tf_efficientnet_b0_ap model
run_finetune_igam_resnext: run an IGAM ResNeXt 101 32x48d fine-tuning job with 320 pixel input size
run_finetune_pnasnet: run a PNASNet fine-tuning job on ImageNet with 8 batch size per GPU
run_finetune_multigpu: run a multi-GPU fine-tuning job across 32 GPUs with NCCL distributed backend
